## Summary

Describe the change and the user or maintenance problem it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Safety review

- [ ] No secrets, private keys, resumes, or production data are included.
- [ ] Database migrations are additive and ordered, or their impact is explained.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and error states were reviewed.
- [ ] Deployment/configuration changes are documented.

## Screenshots or logs

Add relevant evidence, or write “Not applicable”.
